shared_elements: low relief carving of a scene on a rectangular/upright slab
registers or grouped scene of figures
justification: Both show low-relief profile human figures in long garments confronting each other and extending arms with held objects, an offering or presentation-type encounter, and both render bodies with outlined profile heads and patterned hems. However, A is a single large-scale pair of figures filling one field with clearly rendered detail (bucket, ladle-like object, sword), while B stacks smaller figures in at least two registers on a pointed-topped slab with additional small objects/altar-like items and possible sign groups, so the compositional organization differs substantially.
